{{Top|leg}}
'''Shield''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to generate a shield comprised of Ta-Ree energy around their body which gave the appearance of encasing the Ascendant in a topaz-colored crystal. The shield could repel both energy and physical objects, and was an effective counter for many of other offensive Ta-Ree spells such as [[shadowstrike]].

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[boost senses]] and [[psychokinesis]] spells.
